decision.rationale: R3 passed 13 of 14 frozen quality, safety, action, lineage, and dependency gates, but failed the repeated relative p95 gate. The product foundation is retained, but no multimodal retrieval profile is selected.
limitations: The run used nine authored synthetic PDFs and cannot establish real-course performance.
The authored OCR adapter does not qualify a production OCR or layout provider.
The 13-case visual sample has a wide uncertainty interval.
The relative latency gate compares sub-millisecond local operations rather than end-to-end product latency.
The historical 24-case held-out split was not read.
